figures.description: Latest compiled current and estimated source-output power for all combinations.

semantics.means: Counts 4,6,4,1 by N in each load; sample SD across combinations for N1-N3 only. N4 SD absent.
semantics.power: Retained source main voltage multiplied by the compiled sequential branch-current sum; excludes Teensy USB and regulator loss.
semantics.lines: Descriptive mean connectors, not fitted or extrapolated models.

figures.description: Retained source voltages and selected module voltages with latest M0 retests.

semantics.points: 30 source readings and 64 selected module readings; N1 ZERO M0 voltage confirmed as 3.252 V. Two earlier N3 readings shown separately.
semantics.intervals: DMM MIN-MAX, not repeat SD or transient bounds.
semantics.guidelines: Existing project references retained, no new electrical certification.

figures.description: Zero-load and recorded loaded voltage drops for all combinations, with 32 signed loaded-minus-zero module comparisons.

semantics.cells: 1000 × (retained source main V − selected module main V). Cross-record differences, not synchronous drops.
semantics.panels: (a) ZERO, (b) loaded/MAX, (c) loaded/MAX minus ZERO for the same physical combination and module.
semantics.change_labels: Positive increases use +; negative decreases use −; unchanged is 0. Values are differences of selected point readings, not averages.
semantics.change_inference: Descriptive difference between separate recorded conditions; loading equivalence, timing and causal isolation are not established.
semantics.missing: Em dash denotes a physically absent module.
semantics.range: One shared linear data-adaptive colour scale for ZERO and MAX, using nice enclosing bounds from all 64 current branch differences.

color_scale.policy: Linear scale enclosing all plotted values with readable ticks; shared by ZERO and MAX panels in each figure

change_color_scale.policy: Independent linear diverging scale, symmetric about zero with enclosing bounds determined by maximum absolute observed change.

semantics.uncertainty: One selected value per condition/module cell; N1 ZERO M0 voltage and photo assignment are user-confirmed.

figures.description: Separate N=1 records compare blocked zero-load current with continuously read zero-load and loaded current for each recorded module label.

semantics.conditions: 200 Hz FULL, three selected recorded state/load conditions. Each marker is one R1 record.
semantics.module_identity: Labels follow experiment records; physical identity across runs was not independently verified by a hardware UID.
semantics.comparison: Historical blocked records and later continuous records are distinct measurements, not a randomized matched state intervention.
semantics.loaded: Recorded loaded condition; loading equivalence is not established across N.
semantics.exclusions: 100 Hz and blocked loaded screening rows are not used in this state comparison.

figures.description: Recorded branch main currents by physical module, module count and load, retaining every measured module combination.

semantics.points: One branch main reading per active physical module, run and load.
semantics.comparison: Same-module differences across recorded configurations are descriptive; no independent same-configuration repeats.
semantics.jitter: Offsets distinguish load and, where relevant, two different N=3 combinations.
semantics.lines: No connectors or fitted lines because configurations differ.

figures.description: Available absolute temperature observations during continuous USB reads, separated by component and load; no thermal-equilibrium inference.

semantics.STM32: Highest available identified STM32 reading in each run, not a guarantee that every module was measured.
semantics.regulator_and_host: One recorded observation per run; identical values repeated in branch rows are deduplicated.
semantics.missing: Missing temperature values are omitted, never imputed.
semantics.limitations: Different observation timing and unverified stabilization prevent a claim of thermal equilibrium, ambient-normalized rise, or thermal capacity.

figures.description: Separate single-module reference sums and signed residuals for all 11 multi-module combinations under each recorded load label.

semantics.prediction: Sum of separate N=1 main currents of exactly the physical modules present, using the same ZERO/MAX label.
semantics.points: 11 distinct multi-module combinations per load, 22 comparisons total; one compiled entry per combination/load, including two entries with targeted current retests. No independent full-condition repeats.
semantics.residual: 100 × (multi-module branch-current sum − separate N=1 reference sum) / separate N=1 reference sum.
semantics.limitations: Descriptive additivity only; shared modules and batches, no repeatability or instrument-uncertainty estimate. MAX labels do not establish matched load mass/area/distribution.
semantics.axes: Prediction and observation share identical linear limits with equality line. Residual axis includes zero and every observation.

figures.description: Individual combination values, means and combination SD for each module, N=1–4.

semantics.spread: Combination SD only; no complete repeat added

review: Machine checks only; human scientific verification pending
